Join molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL1173655 to include parent and all salts. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join compound_records and docs to retrieve compound_key and pubmed_id_or_doi. Join activities and assays to retrieve assay_description and activity details. Join target_dictionary to retrieve target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Filter by target CHEMBL203 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Return all rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
